policy: Desktop route budget was re-evaluated after removing updater UI from the eagerly-loaded App shell. The route now owns the shared Framer Motion runtime (119,139 bytes), instead of having the old updater banner force that runtime into initial JavaScript; initial JavaScript is lower and this ceiling measures the complete route load. The ceiling is 430,000 bytes against a measured 411,419-byte route graph. Further increases require a performance review. The PDF viewer ceiling remains 510,000 bytes for the PDF.js 6 security upgrade (GHSA-hq66-cqwq-w95j).
